Close to the table · flicks and blocks
FH Block
mouse racket · swipe at the ball = swing · hold left topspin · hold right backspin
click / space toss serve · wheel / W S step back or in · H stroke guide
R restart · first to 11, win by 2

Stroke guide

No menus. A stroke is which button you hold, how hard you swipe at the ball, and where you are. The label above the table shows what you are loaded for.

Hold left · topspin family

Blockkeep the racket still
Drivemedium swipe
Loophard swipe: heavy topspin
Smashhard swipe at a high ball
Flickswipe at a short ball: the racket steps in for you
Banana flickswipe across a short ball: sidespin
Lobfrom far back (wheel down): swipe

Hold right · backspin family

Short pushgentle touch: keeps it short
Pushmedium swipe
Fast long pushhard swipe: deep and quick
Chopfrom far back: swipe

Serve · click then swipe at the falling toss

Topspin / backspinhold left / right while you swipe
Sidespinswipe sideways across the toss
Receivethe next shot is labelled as a receive: short push a short serve, flick or loop a long one

Grips (settings)

Shakehandeven wings, black face on the backhand
Penholdspinnier forehand and serves; backhand can only push, block, drive
Penhold + RPBreverse face frees the backhand: RPB Loop, RPB Banana flick
